cells.forex: Commonly offered through margin; maximum [[leverage]] is set by the broker and often capped by the regulator.
cells.stocks: Not needed when you pay in full; some accounts allow borrowing, which adds leverage and risk.
cells.penny_stocks: Borrowing to buy is often restricted or unavailable; even without it, price swings can be large.
cells.commodities: Often leveraged through futures or broker contracts; funds may have little or none.
cells.futures: Built in: the margin is a small part of the [[notional-value]], so leverage is usually high.

caveat: Limits depend on the jurisdiction, the regulator, the broker, the account type and the product, and can change. Higher allowed leverage is not a reason to use it.
